facts.fact: KRYSTE 未按约定在上午 8:30 出现在曼谷东方酒店大堂；到 10:00 时 KRAY 已喝掉两杯 250 泰铢的咖啡。
facts.anchor: He missed his scheduled 8:30 a.m. appearance in the lobby of Bangkok’s posh Oriental Hotel. It was now 10:00, and KRAY had gone through two 250-baht cups of coffee.

facts.fact: KRAY 给泰国前台职员 400 泰铢并示意他保密，随后离开酒店乘 tuk-tuk 前往 Madrid 酒吧。
facts.anchor: KRAY handed him 400 baht while holding an index finger to his lips, left the hotel, and took a tuk-tuk over to the Madrid.

facts.fact: KRYSTE 说 Madrid 酒吧由 Marty 在 1969 年开设，Marty 离开越南和突击队后开了这家店。
facts.anchor: Opened in ’69 by Marty over there. When he left Vietnam and the Rangers.

facts.fact: KRYSTE 从钱包里拿出一张褪色的五十美元钞票交给 KRAY，那是 BUTTONFLY 在 1968 年 1 月他前往 Khe Sanh 时给他的。
facts.anchor: Then he pulled out his wallet and handed over a faded fifty-dollar bill.

facts.fact: Jim Thompson 故居实际上由六栋房子拼成一栋，Thompson 在 60 年代把它们聚到一起时，每栋已有五十到一百年历史。
facts.anchor: Jim Thompson’s House was in reality six houses joined into one. The six, all fifty to one hundred years old when Thompson brought them together back in the ’60s

facts.fact: KRAY 放弃当天剩余的 SDR 安排，在 Jim Thompson 故居连续逛了五个小时。
facts.anchor: he blew off the remainder of his SDR. He spent the rest of the day wandering through Jim Thompson’s House, five hours straight

facts.fact: Thompson 于 1948 年加入中情局，第一个化名是 John C. PRINGLE。
facts.anchor: Thompson joined the Agency in 1948. His first pseudonym was John C. PRINGLE

facts.fact: Thompson 于 1967 年复活节星期日在马来西亚金马仑高原徒步时失踪。
facts.anchor: when he disappeared in Malaysia on Easter Sunday, 1967, during a brisk walkabout in the Cameron Highlands
